pages.text: A $(item)rift port$() goes inside the room. Conduits against it are joined to the conduits against the gate outside. Any block of the gate will do.

pages.title: One Line
pages.text: Outside: a chest, a conduit pulling from it, touching the gate. Inside: a port, a conduit, a chest.$(br2)That is all. The bread I baked out there is on my table in here. Every gate onto a room feeds that room's ports.
